workflow-overview.alt: Wiring diagram showing model loaders, Director Settings and Reference Pack feeding Master, followed by current-result preview and export.
workflow-overview.caption: A schematic of the core data flow, drawn from the current node contracts. Real ComfyUI screenshots throughout the guide show the actual controls.
workflow-overview.source: Current node schemas and generation pipeline.

master-timeline.alt: Current Master timeline, shared prompt, project audio joins and clip header.
master-timeline.caption: Selection, saved-result status and approval are separate. References appear below the prompt blocks. The clip’s own header contains duration, audio policy, seed and move/duplicate actions.
master-timeline.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

clip-continuity.alt: Clip prompt and Motion Context controls with separate video and audio windows.
clip-continuity.caption: Motion Context on clip 2, with independently selected video/audio context and the New footage duration policy. The chain icon replaces the old overlay cards.
clip-continuity.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

clip-look.alt: Per-clip Look tab with exposure, contrast and saturation controls.
clip-look.caption: Look applies supported per-clip output grading. This is separate from preparing reference pixels in Reference Pack.
clip-look.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

clip-loras.alt: Per-clip LoRAs tab with an enabled patch row, file selector and model strength.
clip-loras.caption: The LoRAs tab owns clip-local model patches. Check the upstream model branch too: this list cannot undo a patch already applied before Master.
clip-loras.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

reference-image.alt: Single-reference editor with image selection, name and multiple reference roles.
reference-image.caption: The pack edits one selected asset at a time. Image roles guide prompt writing; clip type and explicit assignments own actual model conditioning.
reference-image.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

reference-video.alt: Video trim, Video + Audio mode, Megapixels scaling and 0.5 MP input size.
reference-video.caption: Current video preparation: choose streams, trim and Input Size (MP) here. The 0.5 MP setting prepares the input before model reference encoding; it is not output resolution.
reference-video.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

director-settings.alt: Director Settings output canvas, 24 fps, initial sampling schedule and decoded output policy.
director-settings.caption: A saved workflow’s settings can differ from new-node defaults. Here decoded_output is full; latest is usually sufficient when Smart Preview and cached export own sequence review/delivery.
director-settings.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

smart-preview.alt: Current Smart Preview with Full video, Original Resolution, Final Output and four completed clips.
smart-preview.caption: The live player shows all four current clips. Scope, playback resolution and processing stage are independent choices. There is no historical Saved Take selector.
smart-preview.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

selflift-node.alt: SelfLift configuration with low-resolution scale, final high-resolution steps and learned latent upscaler.
selflift-node.caption: A newly added SelfLift node, shown without running it. Only controls relevant to the selected split and tiling choices are visible.
selflift-node.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

refine-node.alt: Refine configuration with extra steps, denoise, global backend and first-pass confirmation.
refine-node.caption: A newly added same-resolution Refine node. Enlargement-only fields appear when their mode is selected. Confirm First Pass must be enabled before generation for the review-then-refine workflow.
refine-node.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.

project-export.alt: Cached project export node with final stream, all clips, FPS and individual shot files.
project-export.caption: Project Video exports current cached results and available current stages. This screenshot shows declared defaults before connecting a timeline; its project ID is a fallback when timeline data already supplies one.
project-export.source: Live ComfyUI frontend, installed pack 1.7.14; separate workflow copies or newly added nodes.
